title: excludeCredentials hits the existing passkey; descriptor carries an unknown transport

unsafe.definition: a second passkey for the same account stored although the second create rejected
InvalidStateError returned before any user consent in the Ferret window (leaks that the credential exists)

note: L3 §6.3.2 step 3: an excluded credential yields InvalidStateError after user consent; §5.8.4: unknown transports MUST be ignored so the hit still counts. Second step is the failing create.
